title: Robots and machines
sub: The model proposes a move; a safety envelope that does not read its reasoning decides what actually moves.

steps.d:
"A part sits at (200, -200, 100)mm from home,
inside the operator station."

steps.h: The model proposes a move toward the part
The envelope refuses: the target is inside a forbidden zone
steps.d:
target is inside forbidden zone: operator station
nothing was sent toward the actuator this step

steps.h: The model proposes a different move, further than the workspace reaches
The envelope clamps: the target is outside the workspace bounds
steps.d:
x: 520 → 300 (workspace bound)
speed 180 is under the 250mm/s cap, unchanged

steps.h: The clamped move reaches the actuator log
steps.d:
move(x=300, y=0, z=50, speed=180)
not the target the model asked for, but a safe one
